card.name: Leading digit of section numbers
card.fires_on: A digit just before a period and a second number, at the start of a numbered label section heading such as 4.1 or 5.2 in drug labels. It also fires on the whole-number part of decimals in dose tables.

modes.label: Section heading numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a subsection number like 4.1 or 5.2 that opens a new heading.

modes.label: Decimal values in tables
modes.description: The whole-number digit of a decimal in a dosing or weight table.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a decimal point plus another digit, and away from a plain digit or space.
card.plain: It marks a digit that is about to be followed by a decimal point, like the 4 in section 4.1.
